label: CPL values entered by you in cpl-overrides.csv
limitation: Used exactly as entered. Not verified by this project.
used_for: Cost-per-lead figures you typed into the CPL sheet. Used exactly as entered.

label: Client language-market research queue (language-market-seeds.csv)
limitation: Qualitative seeds without counts.
used_for: Your language and market research queue (qualitative).

label: Client-provided regional CPL, channel and sales-cycle facts
limitation: Preserved unchanged.
used_for: Regional cost-per-lead benchmarks, channel rates and the 19-case sales timing. The anchor for every cost per lead.

label: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Census 2021: language used at home
limitation: Counts language used at home only.
used_for: Punjabi, Hindi, Urdu, Arabic and Bengali speakers in Australia (language reach).

label: CIA World Factbook, People and Society: Languages (public domain), via the factbook.json mirror; first-language / home-language percentages as published, with the reference year given in each entry
limitation: Census or estimate years differ by country (often 2010-2021). Definitions differ (mother tongue, home language). Many countries publish no percentages.
used_for: First-language percentages by country, used to fill language data where CLDR is thin.

label: Cyprus census 2021 language figures (via Wikipedia table)
limitation: Read from a secondary table.
used_for: Russian speakers in Cyprus (language reach).

label: Eurostat migr_pop1ctz: population on 1 January by age, sex and citizenship
limitation: Citizenship, not country of birth. EU/EFTA residence countries only.
used_for: Diaspora communities in Europe: people by citizenship, used with each origin country's language share.

label: Office for National Statistics, Census 2021 England and Wales: main language
limitation: Main language only, England and Wales only; undercounts speakers who list English as main language.
used_for: Punjabi, Urdu, Arabic and Chinese speakers in England and Wales (language reach).

label: Singapore Department of Statistics, Census 2010 (ethnic and religious categories)
limitation: Ethnic and religious categories, not language.
used_for: Punjabi communities in Singapore (language reach, rough).

label: Statistics Canada, 2021 Census of Population: language
limitation: Ability to speak versus mother tongue differ; the figure used is ability to speak.
used_for: Punjabi speakers in Canada (language reach).

label: Stats NZ, 2018 Census: languages spoken
limitation: The 2023 census gives 49,656 for Punjabi.
used_for: Punjabi speakers in New Zealand (language reach).

label: US Census 2010 language spoken at home
limitation: Old; use the latest ACS table when verified.
used_for: Russian speakers in the US (language reach, old figure).

label: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 2021: language spoken at home
limitation: Survey estimate; the figure was read from a secondary summary, not the table itself.
used_for: Punjabi speakers in the US (language reach).

label: World Bank GDP per capita (PPP) used to scale the modelled cost per lead by country wealth
limitation: The modelled CPL is an estimate anchored on the client's regional benchmarks, not a measured cost.
used_for: Scaling the modelled cost per lead by country wealth.

label: World Bank World Development Indicators (API v2): SP.POP.TOTL, SP.POP.GROW, NY.GDP.PCAP.CD, NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD, IT.NET.USER.ZS; most recent non-empty value per country
limitation: Reference year differs by indicator and country; see *_year columns.
used_for: Population, wealth per head (GDP per capita and PPP) and internet use: purchasing power, reachable audience and the modelled cost per lead.

label: World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators: Political Stability and Absence of Violence (GOV_WGI_PV.EST)
limitation: Perception-based composite index; estimate range about -2.5 to +2.5.
used_for: Political stability, one input to capital access (cross-border readiness).

label: World Bank indicators behind the investment-motivation estimate: stock market capitalisation (% of GDP), personal remittances received (% of GDP), outward investment, consumer price inflation and exchange-rate change
limitation: Used as proxies for the wish to diversify wealth abroad. A proxy for motive, not evidence that anyone buys Dubai property.
used_for: Investment motivations: stock market size, remittances, outward investment, inflation and currency change.

label: Annual bilateral migrant stocks by country of birth, 1960-2022 (imputed), Mendeley Data cpt3nh6jct, file migration_imputed_RIKS_dec2021.csv, year 2020
access: open research data licence (check the dataset page)
limitation: Foreign-born people only (second generation not counted); values are imputed from census and register data, so they are modelled, not counted. Used for destinations Eurostat does not cover.
used_for: Diaspora communities outside Europe (UK, US, Canada, Australia, Gulf and more): people by country of birth, used with each origin's language share.

label: Betterhomes Dubai transaction split (end user vs investor), as reported by Gulf News
limitation: Market-wide only; sample size not stated; no nationality split.
used_for: Background only: end-user versus investor share of Dubai buyers.

label: Brokerage analyses of Dubai Land Department buyer nationalities, 2024-2025 (Benhams, Dubai Tax and Property, Smart Zones, Hanok International, Alsro and others)
limitation: Shares quoted by brokers (India about 22%, UK about 17%, China about 14%, Saudi Arabia about 11%, Russia about 9%). The Dubai Land Department does not publish exact nationality percentages, so these vary by source and period.
used_for: Dubai demand for countries with no search data: reported share of buyers by nationality.

label: Country opportunity scores: six dimensions (Dubai demand, financial capacity, motivations, capital access, reachable audience, acquisition economics) with editable weights and client-sales boosts
limitation: Built from the sources above. Missing data counts as a cautious 40 and lowers the score. A model of potential, not a forecast of sales.
used_for: The country scores behind Market comparison, the map colours and the close rate for each market.

label: DXBinteract-derived international Dubai property-interest data as reported by Palmstone Properties and V Capital Research
limitation: Search/interest share, not transactions or buyers. Independent validation against DXBinteract/DLD pending.
used_for: Dubai demand: each country's share of international Dubai property searches (top countries only).

label: ISO 639-1 / ISO 639-3 language codes
limitation: Codes only.
used_for: Language codes and names.

label: Knight Frank / YouGov Destination Dubai 2025 survey, as summarised in public search results and press coverage
limitation: Figures were read from secondary summaries; the infographic PDF could not be mapped label-to-number reliably. 387 HNWI respondents. Intentions, not purchases.
used_for: Background on buyer intent, read from press summaries.

label: Knight Frank Destination Dubai 2025 HNWI survey
limitation: Survey of 387 HNWIs in India, UK, Saudi Arabia, East Asia. Country figures not extracted.
used_for: Background on buyer intent (HNWI survey). Not turned into country scores.

label: Unicode CLDR supplementalData territoryInfo (language population percent by territory)
limitation: Does not separate first and second language; figures for some territories are old. Used as a language-reach proxy, not a census.
used_for: Share of each country's population that uses each language: the main language reach figure.

label: Bengali diaspora population figures from secondary summaries (UK, US, Saudi Arabia)
limitation: Ethnic or population figures, not language counts.
used_for: Bengali communities in the UK, US and Saudi Arabia (language reach, rough).

label: Gulf Labour Markets and Migration, Migratory Flows of Russian-speaking Populations to the UAE
limitation: No official breakdown by language; estimates differ widely.
used_for: Russian speakers in the UAE (language reach).

label: Joshua Project / PeopleGroups people-group population estimates
limitation: Mission-research estimates of ethnic groups, not a census. Sources disagree by up to 50%.
used_for: Punjabi communities in the UAE and Malaysia (language reach, rough).

label: Order-of-magnitude figures not verified by a source in this research
limitation: Included so a country with a large known community is not shown as zero. Replace with a census figure when checked.
used_for: A few large communities with no source found (for example Arabic in France and the US). Placeholders to replace.

label: Pakistani and Indian expatriate populations in Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman and Bahrain (Wikipedia compilations of national and IDSA figures)
limitation: Nationals multiplied by an assumed share who use Urdu or Hindi. Years and sources differ; Oman Indian figures conflict by 2x.
used_for: Hindi and Urdu in Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman and Bahrain, from expatriate counts (language reach, rough).

label: UAE expatriate nationality shares from public summaries (Indians about 27-35%, Pakistanis about 12-17% of roughly 11 million)
limitation: No census by language. Language shares inside each nationality are assumptions.
used_for: Hindi, Urdu and Punjabi in the UAE, from expatriate nationality shares (language reach, rough).

label: US Chinese speakers, advocacy summary of Census data (AAJC) and Census Bureau 2019 report
limitation: All Chinese varieties; Mandarin alone not separated.
used_for: Chinese speakers in the US (language reach, rough).

label: United States Urdu speakers, 2013 figure quoted on Wikipedia language pages
limitation: Old figure from a secondary source; the current ACS table was not read.
used_for: Urdu speakers in the US (language reach, old figure).

label: Dubai Land Department / Dubai Pulse / DXBinteract buyer-nationality transaction series
limitation: Research gap: no verified nationality-level transaction counts were obtained.
